title: Time it
brief: The glow fades on a clock set by R × C, resistance times capacitance, in seconds: 1 kΩ × 1000 µF = 1 s.
Make the afterglow last 1.2–4 s (until it fades to a fifth of its brightness). The bin has three resistors and two capacitors: pick the pair.
lesson: The fade here takes about 1.6 × R × C, so doubling either part doubles it. The 555 runs on this same clock: it watches a capacitor fill through a resistor.
